observations: Photo 0 shows a 4-burner gas stove with black enamel top, metal grates, and four control knobs with flame symbols. The surface has visible wear, stains, and some rust around the burners.
Photo 1 shows the back of the stove, revealing a metal casing with screws, a power cord, and a label with a barcode and text. The metal is dirty and shows signs of rust and wear.
Photo 2 shows the same stove with the grates and burner caps removed, exposing the burner ports. The top surface is stained and has residue around the burner holes. The control knobs are intact.
No brand or model is visible in any photo. The label in photo 1 is too blurry to read.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show visible stains, residue, and rust on the surface and around the burners. Photo 1 shows rust and dirt on the back panel.
No technical specifications or performance data are visible in the photos. This claim cannot be verified remotely.

risks.risk: The stove may not work or may have damaged burners or gas lines.
risks.proof: A video showing the stove lit on all burners, or close-up photos of the burner ports and gas valves.

risks.risk: The stove may have internal corrosion or damage to the gas manifold or electrical components.
risks.proof: Photos of the internal components, especially the gas connections and control valve assembly.
risks.if_unproven: priced as potentially unsafe or non-functional

risks.risk: The stove may be missing parts or have broken components (e.g., grates, caps, knobs).
risks.proof: A complete inventory photo showing all parts included with the stove.

proof_requests: Video of the stove lighting on all burners.
Close-up of the label on the back panel (photo 1) to read the brand and model.
Photos of the internal gas connections and control valve.
Photo showing all included parts (grates, caps, knobs, etc.).
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a 4-burner gas stove, but the seller's claim of cleanliness is contradicted by visible stains and rust. The claim of low gas consumption is unverifiable. Critical risks include possible non-functionality, internal damage, and missing parts. Without proof of working condition and full parts, a price cannot be determined.
